metadata.title: Security Assessment Results - Shibboleth Identity Provider
metadata.remarks: OSCAL Security Assessment Results documenting the assessment of the Institutional Shibboleth Identity Provider, including identified risks, control deviations, and remediation plans.

activities.title: Authentication Flow Review
activities.description: Review of Shibboleth authentication flow configuration and directory fallback behavior.

methods.title: Configuration Analysis
methods.description: Analysis of authentication configuration, logs, and documented behavior.

findings.title: Legacy LDAP Fallback on Authentication Failure
findings.description: Shibboleth authentication flow permits fallback to legacy LDAP following authentication failure against ad.utoronto.ca.

related-observations.description: Authentication logs demonstrate legacy LDAP fallback after failed AD authentication attempts.

risk.statement: Permissive fallback behavior undermines authentication assurance by allowing federated authentication via a legacy repository after failure of the authoritative directory.

results.title: Targeted Assessment - Shibboleth Identity Provider
results.description: Assessment of federated authentication and identity assurance controls.

observations.title: Authentication Fallback Behavior
observations.description: Fallback to legacy LDAP occurs for both account-not-found and authentication-failure conditions.

findings.description: Fallback on authentication failure enables weak assurance paths.

remediation.description: Restrict legacy LDAP fallback to account-not-found scenarios only; treat authentication failure against ad.utoronto.ca as terminal.

risks.title: Identity Assurance Degradation
risks.description: Federated authentication assurance may be inconsistent due to permissive fallback behavior.
risks.statement: Until remediation is implemented, Shibboleth authentication may rely on legacy controls following failure of the authoritative directory.

poam-items.title: Restrict Legacy LDAP Fallback
poam-items.description: Modify authentication flow to restrict legacy LDAP usage to account-not-found conditions only.
